title: ARWP Growth Profile
goal: Turn source-backed Search, generative-search, citation and agent-web guidance into a prioritized website improvement plan without promising ranking or recommendation outcomes.

opportunities.title: Make important pages non-commodity and evidence-led
opportunities.claim: Google's 2026 generative-search guide says unique, expert-led, non-commodity content and first-hand perspective are more important than AI-only markup, chunking or keyword variants.

opportunities.title: Make authorship and production evidence explicit
opportunities.claim: Google's people-first guidance recommends making it clear who created content, adding accurate bylines where expected, linking to author background, and explaining how content was produced when that context helps readers.

opportunities.title: Publish one coherent entity identity
opportunities.claim: Google recommends Organization structured data with applicable identity properties such as name, URL, logo and sameAs; author/profile structured data can help disambiguate creators where applicable.

opportunities.title: Keep visible and structured publication dates consistent
opportunities.claim: Google recommends prominent user-visible publication/update dates and consistent datePublished/dateModified structured data where applicable; dates should reflect real publication or significant updates.

opportunities.title: Separate AI search/reference access from model training preferences
opportunities.claim: Cloudflare Content Signals distinguish search, ai-input and ai-train uses, and its newer use directive can express immediate/reference/full reuse. Cloudflare's crawl endpoint now enforces these signals for compatible requests.
opportunities.notes: This is a Cloudflare-defined policy mechanism, not a Google ranking requirement or universal web standard.

opportunities.title: Allow OAI-SearchBot independently from GPTBot training policy
opportunities.claim: OpenAI documents OAI-SearchBot for ChatGPT Search discovery separately from GPTBot training controls, allowing publishers to choose search visibility without making the same choice for training.

opportunities.title: Give loyal readers a Preferred Sources action
opportunities.claim: Google Preferred Sources is globally available for Top Stories and can highlight selected sources in AI Mode and AI Overviews where those features are available.
opportunities.notes: User preference can increase prominence for users who selected the source; it is not a general ranking guarantee.

opportunities.title: Track generative Search visibility as a first-class KPI
opportunities.claim: As of August 31, 2026 Google says Generative AI performance insights in Search Console are rolled out to all websites worldwide.

opportunities.title: Track citations and grounding queries in Bing AI Performance
opportunities.claim: Bing Webmaster Tools AI Performance reports cited pages, citation activity and grounding queries across supported Microsoft AI experiences.

opportunities.title: Measure the brand's social/video search footprint
opportunities.claim: Google Search Console platform properties are globally available for Instagram, TikTok, X and YouTube, enabling creators to measure how those surfaces perform in Search, Discover and Google News.

opportunities.title: Support important pages with relevant original visual media
opportunities.claim: Google's generative-search guide says relevant high-quality images and video create additional opportunities for a site to appear beyond web-page links.

opportunities.title: Do not add FAQ markup solely for a Google rich-result advantage
opportunities.claim: Google deprecated FAQ rich results starting May 7, 2026. FAQPage markup may still have non-Google or semantic uses, but it should not be sold as a current Google rich-result growth tactic.

opportunities.title: Protect topical reputation from third-party parasite content
opportunities.claim: Google's site reputation abuse policy targets third-party content published primarily to exploit the host site's ranking signals; Google updated its EEA enforcement approach in August 2026 but the underlying quality concern remains.

opportunities.title: Make evidence-bearing sections directly addressable
opportunities.claim: Google's 2026 Read more guidance recommends visible target content and preserving URL fragments so Search can deep-link users to relevant page sections.

opportunities.title: Treat AI-only files as interoperability, not Google ranking signals
opportunities.claim: Google explicitly says llms.txt and other special AI markup are not needed for Google Search and do not help or harm Google visibility; ARWP should use such files only where another consumer has a real interoperability use case.
